self_support: Preferred; insufficient self-holding alone does not reject a manually supported static pose
manual_support_during_capture: Support without moving the intended pose; capture still requires stable, fresh, valid data
ordinary_metal_parts: User-selected Taobao D4 L8 M3 thread6 AF3, washers, A8 springs and stock fasteners
protocol_semantics: Preserve axis IDs and fixed/missing/fault states; manual support changes no channel state
same_or_adjacent_joint_collision: Hard design defect requiring redesign; do not waive
nonadjacent_body_contact: Pose restriction/warning; retain witnesses and avoid by adjusting pose
anatomical_mismatch: Limited mismatch may be considered; no numeric tolerance approved, clavicle and wrist deviations remain open
mandatory_print_bed_check: Flat-face contact, actual supported slicing, support footprint and supplier actual-machine/material review
